dsh-model-failover 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。两级模型熔断与回退：模型或平台连续失败后自动熔断，并把下一个请求路由到配置好的备用模型。

posts.en:
dsh-model-failover is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Two-level model circuit breaker with failover: trip a model or a whole provider after repeated request failures and route the next request to a configured fallback.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-13ec937317f18183bde3.html
